title: verify.rs: per-signer errors captured in SignerResult rather than propagated — correct for multi-signer CMS
description: verify_one() captures all per-signer failures in SignerResult.error rather than propagating them as Err. verify() then returns Ok only when at least one signer succeeded. This is the correct behavior for CMS SignedData which can have multiple independent signers: failing one does not invalidate the others. A future contributor might simplify to '?' propagation inside verify_one(). That would cause verify() to fail when any signer fails, breaking valid multi-signer messages. The current design is required by RFC 5652 §5.6.
